config.prompt_template:
Answer this question about the company Kestrel Analytics from your own knowledge.
If you don't know, say so.

Return ONLY a JSON object: {"answer": "<string>"}

Question: <question>

questions.question: What does error KST-2044 mean and how do I fix it?
questions.expected_answer: The data source refused the connection because the Kestrel IP addresses are not on its allowlist. Add both 203.0.113.10 and 203.0.113.11; adding only one causes intermittent errors.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics or the error code KST-2044."}

questions.question: A user gets KST-4012 when accepting an invitation. What should support tell them?
questions.expected_answer: There is no free seat. An Admin must free a seat, or the Owner must add seats or upgrade. The same invitation then works if it is less than 7 days old.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics or the specific error code KST-4012."}

questions.question: What happens, step by step, when a customer's card payment fails?
questions.expected_answer: E-mail to the Owner and billing contact, retries after 1, 3 and 7 days, then a 21-day grace period (everything works), then read-only, then suspension at 60 days. Nothing is deleted.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics or its specific step-by-step process for handling failed card payments."}

questions.question: Which plans include single sign-on, and how does an admin set it up?
questions.expected_answer: Business and Enterprise. An Admin opens Settings → Security → Single sign-on, downloads the Kestrel SP metadata, registers Kestrel in the identity provider, pastes the IdP metadata URL back, tests with one Admin, then enforces it.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics' pricing plans or single sign-on (SSO) setup instructions."}

questions.question: I lost my phone and I can't log in anymore. What can I do?
questions.expected_answer: Use a backup code. Without one, ask a workspace Admin to reset your second factor. If you are the only Admin or the Owner, contact support from the account's e-mail address; identity verification can take up to 2 business days.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have specific information about Kestrel Analytics' account recovery procedures. Please contact Kestrel Analytics support or your organization's IT helpdesk to reset your multi-factor authentication (MFA) device and regain access to your account."}

questions.question: Can I get a refund on my annual plan 45 days after it renewed?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, under the current (March 2026) policy: annual plans are refundable within 60 days of renewal, pro-rated from the request date. The old 2025 policy allowed only 30 days.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have specific information about Kestrel Analytics' refund policy to confirm if a refund is available 45 days after an annual plan renewal."}

questions.question: How much do I save by paying annually instead of monthly?
questions.expected_answer: 20% compared with twelve months of monthly billing (it was 15% under the 2025 policy).
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics' pricing or annual discount rates."}

questions.question: Error KST-5031 happened on the last two scheduled reports. Which team should support contact, and where?
questions.expected_answer: Messaging, which owns postroom: post in #oncall-messaging as SEV-2. Outside 08:00–20:00 on weekdays, escalate to the Platform on-call.
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics or Error KST-5031."}

questions.question: Is there a Kestrel mobile app for iPhone?
questions.model_output: {"answer": "Yes, Kestrel offers mobile apps for iPhone available on the Apple App Store, such as the Kestrel LiNK app used to connect to Kestrel devices and manage environmental data."}

questions.question: How much does one seat cost per month on the Business plan?
questions.expected_answer: Not in the documents (the billing policy says prices are on the pricing page).
questions.model_output: {"answer": "I do not have information about Kestrel Analytics or the cost of a seat on their Business plan."}
